name: Hextris
description: An addictive, hexagonal twist on classic puzzle gaming. Blocks slide down towards the central hexagon, and you must rotate it to match colors before they stack up.
instructions: Blocks of different colors fall from the outer screen edges towards the central gray hexagon.
Match three or more blocks of the same color on a flat surface to make them pop and score points.
Prevent the blocks from stacking up outside the outer gray boundary.

description: Combine falling tiles of equal value to reach the legendary 2048 tile. It requires forward planning and strategic tile routing to avoid running out of space.
instructions: Move all tiles on the grid in any of the four directions (Up, Down, Left, Right).
When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one with the doubled value.
The challenge is to keep merging tiles until you combine two 1024s into the 2048 tile!

name: Classic PAC-MAN
description: Relive the legendary 1980 arcade phenomenon in this crisp, responsive HTML5 implementation. Wander down narrow pathways eating dots and pellets.
instructions: Steer PAC-MAN around the maze consuming yellow pellets while avoiding the four colorful ghosts.
Eat large flashing Power Pellets to temporarily weaken the ghosts and consume them for extra points.
Clear the entire labyrinth of dots to advance to the next level.

name: Neo Tetris
description: The quintessential line-matching puzzle game compiled to pure HTML5 canvas. Arrange falling, rotating geometric shapes into persistent, complete horizontal blocks.
instructions: Control the falling tetromino blocks as they descend.
Rotate and translate blocks so they form complete horizontal rows.
Completed lines instantly vanish, giving you additional score and vertical space.

name: Flappy Bird
description: Tap your wings to maintain vertical height and pass through endless sequences of green pipes. Highly punishing, addictive clicker gameplay.
instructions: Flap your wings to lift the bird upwards.
Dodge every incoming pipe obstacle. Colliding with any part of a pipe or the ground instantly ends the round.
Compete for the highest scores as the gap gets narrower!

name: Space Invaders
description: Protect the planetary defense grid from endless legions of alien formations. Hide behind temporary barriers and unleash constant laser volleys.
instructions: Slide left and right to evade descending alien units.
Shoot laser beans upward to destroy the fleet. Speed up your dodging as alien formations approach.
Take shelter behind green barricades while firing back.

name: Vapor Breakout
description: Bounce an elastic energy sphere to smash patterns of glowing bricks. Prevent the ball from slipping under your paddle at all costs.
instructions: Move your horizontal paddle left and right to intercept the bouncing ball.
Destroy all blocks on the screen to progress to the next brick pattern.
Angling the block hit controls the kinetic deflection of the ball.

name: A Dark Room
description: An award-winning minimalist text adventure that starts inside a cold, silent room and expands into a deep post-apocalyptic resource manager.
instructions: Stoke the fire to keep light in the room, then invite mysterious travelers inside.
Gather lumber, construct tools, build huts, and coordinate a healthy thriving community.
Venture outside into the sandy wilderness mapping resources, but stay supplied.

controls.Left Mouse Click: Execute text selections, fire stoking, and grid travel
